about: Quotes shown on the 404 page. Every quote needs a source link and is checked by scripts/check-quotes.mjs during the build. Rules approved by Chris on 23 Nov 2026: every quote verified against a real source; mix of Malaysian and international figures; no sitting politicians; original language shown, and a translation only where a sourced one exists (never translated by us); short quotes with attribution; older or public-domain sources preferred. Only the four international quotes are approved so far; Malaysian figures are to be added later after verification.

quotes.text: One child, one teacher, one book and one pen can change the world.
quotes.author: Malala Yousafzai
quotes.work: Speech to the UN Youth Assembly, New York
quotes.sourceLabel: Transcript (Iowa State University, American Women's Public Speech archive); also reported by the AP and UN News
quotes.note: UN News words it slightly shorter; the transcript wording is used.

quotes.text: Education is the most powerful weapon we can use to change the world.
quotes.author: Nelson Mandela
quotes.work: Speech at the launch of Mindset Network, Johannesburg
quotes.sourceLabel: Nelson Mandela Foundation archive, item ZA COM MR-S-909
quotes.note: The widely shared version with 'which you can use' is not the wording in the Foundation's transcript.

quotes.text: Education, then, beyond all other devices of human origin, is the great equalizer of the conditions of men, the balance-wheel of the social machinery.
quotes.author: Horace Mann
quotes.work: Twelfth Annual Report to the Massachusetts Board of Education (Report No. 12)
quotes.sourceLabel: Transcription of Report No. 12, East Tennessee State University
quotes.note: Public domain. The source page gives no page number.

quotes.text: In teaching there should be no distinction of classes.
quotes.author: Confucius
quotes.work: Analects, book 15 (Wei Ling Gong), chapter 39 (chapter 38 in Legge's numbering)
quotes.check: The Chinese characters were confirmed from secondary pages only, because ctext.org could not be opened when this was logged. Open the ctext link once to confirm.
